name: Overshoot: fixing both makes it worse
pattern: non-monotone: all replacements together fail, one alone works
story: A shipment weight check expects 6 kg. Two parcels were logged too light. Fixing only the first parcel gives exactly 6. Fixing both gives 9, so the full set of replacements fails while a smaller set passes. This is why a search must test combinations and cannot judge from the all-replacements run.
